reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I saved the 8 April date as **unverified** and couldn't confirm it.

- **What I checked:** I looked through the shared files and the #central-team history, which Pree can see too. Neither has anything on Brackenwater Freight Co.: no contract, no CRM record and no renewal date.
- **What I saved:** a note for #central-team saying a customer said the next renewal is 8 April, heard by Pree on a call on 14 Oct and not checked against any record. Pree had already posted this in the channel, so the note doesn't reveal anything new.
- **What I advised:** treat the date as hearsay until the account owner or the signed contract confirms it. Until then, keep it out of trackers and customer emails.
